events.text: A trestle desk under a hand-lettered sign: SIGN ON. {name} sits behind it with a ledger, a stamp and a long line of nobody. 'The capital's best are all spoken for,' {name} says, 'but the ones that are not are very good, and they are mine, and I would like to find them homes.' The ledger is open at a page of names. Several have small drawings next to them.

outcomes.text: {name} stamps the page, hands you a ticket, and a recruit of the capital's own people steps out of the queue, bag already packed. 'They have been waiting for the right ship,' {name} says. 'Or any ship. Mind them.'

{name} turns the ledger around and runs a finger down it. 'Cooks, fixers, two who talk to walls, one who does not talk at all. Take your pick, or come back when you have a berth.' You get the sense that it is a courtesy, and that {name} is already marking you down as someone to remember.

choices.text: Leave the line to the next in it.

outcomes.text: 'There is no next,' says {name}. 'There never is. Go on.'
